knowledge.name: Synthetic broadband service snapshot
knowledge.detail: Five fictional customer services with plan, cabinet, status, drops in 7 days, open case, guided fix steps, and visit rule.

knowledge.name: Local network work records
knowledge.detail: Two fictional work records: a planned cabinet maintenance window and an in-progress emergency cable repair.

knowledge.name: Visit history and technician roster
knowledge.detail: Four previous visits with outcomes and notes, plus five technicians with skills, area, and next slot.

knowledge.name: Booking drafts and guardrail rules
knowledge.detail: Five per-service booking drafts with job preparation, plus routing, evidence, and no-write rules.

intelligence_processing.name: Guided connection fix lookup
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns the service status and step-by-step fix for the call, with the rule for when to book a visit.

intelligence_processing.name: Local work matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches planned or emergency network work to a service so a visit is not booked during an outage.

intelligence_processing.name: Previous visit retrieval
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists earlier visit outcomes and technician notes for the service, or states none are recorded.

intelligence_processing.name: Technician and job preparation draft
intelligence_processing.detail: Names the recommended technician, skills, next slot, booking status, and job preparation as a draft.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed service resolution
intelligence_processing.detail: Resolves a service by key or name, defaults to the demo service, and never substitutes an unknown one.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio first-call experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with four skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file FirstTimeFixAgent locally with deterministic routing over the broadband snapshot.

clients_user_interface.name: Contact center call support
clients_user_interface.detail: Answers lead with the fix, local work, or booking draft while the customer is still on the call.

management_reporting.name: Guided fix card
management_reporting.detail: Plan, status, drops, open case, numbered fix steps, visit rule, local work, and flag for one service.

management_reporting.name: Technician booking draft
management_reporting.detail: Recommended technician, next slot, booking status, and job preparation; no visit is booked.

management_reporting.name: First-call acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Four locked contact center and dispatcher cases, one per operation, with exact anchors.

tools.name: Portable FirstTimeFixAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with four deterministic read-only operations over synthetic records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill package; publishing stays with an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for cases and service status; no live connection in the package.

tools.name: Network maintenance and outage records
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for planned and emergency network work; synthetic records stand in.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Field Service
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for visits and technician schedules; nothing is booked or dispatched.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic broadband evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every service, cabinet, case, visit, technician, and slot is invented; no browsing or live-system claims.

supporting_features.name: No booking or customer contact
supporting_features.detail: Never books, changes, or cancels a visit, changes a service, updates a case, or contacts a customer.

supporting_features.name: Human booking confirmation
supporting_features.detail: A contact center agent or field service dispatcher confirms every booking through future authenticated tools.

supporting_features.name: Four routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Guided fix, local work check, visit history, and technician booking each answer one bounded question.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
